title: Hierarchical structures of GO-supported BiBTC MOFs for efficient RhB photodegradation
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2779-2791
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA08337G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Van Cuong Nguyen, Trinh Duy Nguyen, Qui Thanh Hoai Ta, Ai Le Hoang Pham
A graphene oxide@BiBTC MOF photocatalyst was prepared by in situ using a hydrothermal method. The as-prepared composite was applied in five cycles for RhB with 90% photodegrading efficiency.
